summary.text: Обновление пина внешнего действия AI-Code Review с версии 1.0.2 (commit dc359e7...) на версию 1.1.0 (commit 977c912...). В комментарии указано, что новая версия выводит находки непосредственно на строках diff.

Цитата R28 из файла .github/workflows/ai-code-review.yml (commit fe9030e...) содержит строку с uses: PeshkovND/AI-Advent-Challenge@977c91233e221f529cb0382909d5e756befeb19c, что соответствует ожидаемому SHA в инструкции.

limits: One real CI workflow change; not a full evaluation of application-code release analysis.
The manual check verified the pinned SHA in the Git snapshot. The GitHub workflow itself was not executed.
Semantic checks are probabilistic; early Qwen 4B runs produced unsupported guesses and missed incomplete citations. The final version adds code rules for CI pin changes and both sides of small diffs.
Tickets, documentation edits, Xcode checks and store publishing are not implemented. Cloud provider was not exercised in this live run.
